credit_line: Gift of Juan and Anna Marie Hamilton
description: 1" angular Paint Brush.  Printed on handle in gold: "4255-229 ANGULAR ALL PUREBRISTLE MASTERSET".  Handle is stained wood with a glossy finish and a hole drilled through at the end.  The ferule is silver with "MADE IN U.S.A" stamped into it on one side and "1"" stamped into it on the other with "185" in ink above the "1"".  The ferule is cut at an angle at the bristle end to match the angle of the bristles.  The bristles are light in color with the exception of a few black ones and are cut at an angle.
dimensions:
Length: 11 in 
width at bristles: 1 in
